stations.criterion: At least 80% of qualified applications sent within 10 min; only fit and content checked applications count as timely successes; the full eligible denominator stays

stations.short: You answer quickly and helpfully.
stations.requirement: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass
stations.criterion: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass

stations.short: You follow up on the agreed day.
stations.requirement: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count
stations.criterion: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count

stations.short: You keep your application commitment.
stations.requirement: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment
stations.criterion: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment

stations.short: You send useful proposals promptly after calls.
stations.requirement: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded
stations.criterion: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded

stations.short: You give invitations a useful answer.
stations.requirement: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour
stations.criterion: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour

stations.short: You guide calls towards a clear agreement.
stations.requirement: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason
stations.criterion: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason

stations.short: You keep all five working habits.
stations.requirement: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each
stations.criterion: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each

stations.short: You review your week with evidence.
stations.requirement: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks
stations.criterion: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks

stations.short: You win new work.
stations.requirement: At least one new contract is won in the completed week
stations.criterion: At least one new contract is won in the completed week

stations.short: You return and pick things up.
stations.requirement: Return after at least two missed full weeks; one Bronze tier, retained once earned
stations.criterion: Return after at least two missed full weeks; one Bronze tier, retained once earned

stations.short: You give invitations a useful answer.

stations.criterion: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason

stations.short: Your applications start more conversations.
stations.requirement: Reply rate: full mature outbound application cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 11%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Reply rate: full mature outbound application cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 11%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: Your conversations move towards a call.
stations.requirement: Call rate: full mature reply cohort, including call, offer and contract progression, Wilson lower bound at least 30%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Call rate: full mature reply cohort, including call, offer and contract progression, Wilson lower bound at least 30%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: Your calls turn into won work.
stations.requirement: Held call to won: full mature 28-day call cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 20%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Held call to won: full mature 28-day call cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 20%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: You send fitting applications while jobs are fresh.
stations.requirement: At least 80% of qualified applications sent within 10 min; only fit and content checked applications count as timely successes; the full eligible denominator stays
stations.criterion: At least 80% of qualified applications sent within 10 min; only fit and content checked applications count as timely successes; the full eligible denominator stays

stations.short: You answer quickly and helpfully.
stations.requirement: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass
stations.criterion: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass

stations.short: You follow up on the agreed day.
stations.requirement: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count
stations.criterion: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count

stations.short: You keep your application commitment.
stations.requirement: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment
stations.criterion: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment

stations.short: You send useful proposals promptly after calls.
stations.requirement: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded
stations.criterion: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded

stations.short: You give invitations a useful answer.
stations.requirement: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour
stations.criterion: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour

stations.short: You guide calls towards a clear agreement.
stations.requirement: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason
stations.criterion: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason

stations.short: You keep all five working habits.
stations.requirement: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each
stations.criterion: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each

stations.short: You review your week with evidence.
stations.requirement: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks
stations.criterion: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks

stations.short: You win new work.
stations.requirement: At least one new contract is won in the completed week
stations.criterion: At least one new contract is won in the completed week

stations.short: You return and pick things up.

stations.criterion: Return after at least two missed full weeks; one Bronze tier, retained once earned

stations.short: Your applications start more conversations.
stations.requirement: Reply rate: full mature outbound application cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 11%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Reply rate: full mature outbound application cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 11%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: Your conversations move towards a call.
stations.requirement: Call rate: full mature reply cohort, including call, offer and contract progression, Wilson lower bound at least 30%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Call rate: full mature reply cohort, including call, offer and contract progression, Wilson lower bound at least 30%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: Your calls turn into won work.
stations.requirement: Held call to won: full mature 28-day call cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 20%, after the baseline is set
stations.criterion: Held call to won: full mature 28-day call cohort, Wilson lower bound at least 20%, after the baseline is set

stations.short: You send fitting applications while jobs are fresh.
stations.requirement: At least 80% of qualified applications sent within 10 min; only fit and content checked applications count as timely successes; the full eligible denominator stays
stations.criterion: At least 80% of qualified applications sent within 10 min; only fit and content checked applications count as timely successes; the full eligible denominator stays

stations.short: You answer quickly and helpfully.
stations.requirement: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass
stations.criterion: Useful first answer: working-hours median at most 5 min and p75 at most 15 min, with passed retained applicable conversation content checks or explicit content pass

stations.short: You follow up on the agreed day.
stations.requirement: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count
stations.criterion: All due silent-lane follow-ups completed on their business day; cancelled obligations before due day do not count

stations.short: You keep your application commitment.
stations.requirement: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment
stations.criterion: Qualified application commitment met; fit pass or reviewed unclear counts; no extra recognition above the commitment

stations.short: You send useful proposals promptly after calls.
stations.requirement: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded
stations.criterion: At least 90% of fitting held calls receive a passed-content proposal within 30 min of call end; clean disqualification and offer or contract bypasses excluded

stations.short: You give invitations a useful answer.
stations.requirement: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour
stations.criterion: All eligible invitations receive a useful passed-content response within 1 working hour

stations.short: You guide calls towards a clear agreement.
stations.requirement: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason
stations.criterion: A reviewed call meets at least 7/9 of applicable points; informed disqualification counts; every not needed point has a reason

stations.short: You keep all five working habits.
stations.requirement: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each
stations.criterion: All five habits meet their targets and the timeliness content checks pass, with eligible opportunities for each

stations.short: You review your week with evidence.
stations.requirement: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks
stations.criterion: An evidenced weekly analytics review is completed; missed command runs do not erase qualifying weeks

stations.short: You win new work.
stations.requirement: At least one new contract is won in the completed week
stations.criterion: At least one new contract is won in the completed week

stations.short: You return and pick things up.
stations.requirement: Return after at least two missed full weeks; one Bronze tier, retained once earned
stations.criterion: Return after at least two missed full weeks; one Bronze tier, retained once earned
